hook_prompt_class.py. Every word and every fixture phrase here is
invented for this file: no owner's words, no seat's shorthand.
SHAPE: classes.<LABEL>.words (or .openers for QUESTION) is what tier 1
matches against a prompt. fixtures.<LABEL> is a list of {text, reason}
objects: ten neutral phrases per class, used by --selftest to grade
tier-1 accuracy and to build the tier-2 few-shot block.
Copy this file's shape (not its words) into the path named by
kit.config's PROMPT_CLASS_FIXTURES to overlay or replace a class's
words or fixtures with your own -- see that key's comment in
writes the RULING half of that overlay for you, from your own
